class.description: dfinterface implementation that creates dummy rob fragments

attribute.name: poisonPillServer
attribute.description: Server name for poison pill

attribute.name: poisonPillName
attribute.description: Name of the ISObject which will trigger NoMoreEvents exception.

class.description: dfinterface implementation that reads events from files

attribute.name: fileList
attribute.description: List of files to read

attribute.name: loopOverFiles
attribute.description: Whether to loop over files or not

class.name: HLTDataSourceImpl
class.description: Base class for HLTMPPU DataSource Implementations

attribute.name: library
attribute.description: Library name to load for HLTMPPU data source

attribute.name: extraParams
attribute.description: Extra parameters to pass to DataFlow apps

class.name: HLTImplementationDB
class.description: OKS type for HLT running through a database connection

attribute.name: hltPrescaleKey
attribute.description: Configuration key for HLT prescale set

attribute.name: additionalConnectionParameters
attribute.description: additional connection string parameters

relationship.name: HLTCommonParameters
relationship.description: Relationshipt to common HLT configuration parameters.

class.name: HLTImplementationDBPython
class.description: OKS type for HLT running through a database connection including Python pre/postCommand. This is for debugging purposes only and should not be used for online running.

attribute.name: preCommand
attribute.description: A set of python commands or script to be executed before DB configuration.

attribute.name: postCommand
attribute.description: A set of python commands or script to be executed after DB configuration.

class.name: HLTImplementationJobOptions
class.description: OKS type for python JobOption HLT running.

attribute.name: jobOptionsPath
attribute.description: Path (full or relative) to the top-level jobotions you want run with.

attribute.name: pythonSetupFile
attribute.description: The bootstrapping python file for the PSC

attribute.name: logLevel
attribute.description: The logging level to be set at the MessageService

attribute.name: preCommand
attribute.description: A set of python commands to be executed just before the execution of your top-level jobOptions.

attribute.name: postCommand
attribute.description: A set of python commands to be executed just after reading your top-level python joboptions, near the end of the configuration phase

relationship.name: HLTCommonParameters
relationship.description: Common parameters that dictate common behavior between python jobOptions and DB implementations of the PSC configuration

class.name: HLTMPPUApplication
class.description: Multi processing HLT Processing Unit application

attribute.name: library
attribute.description: name of the library to load

attribute.name: extraParams
attribute.description: Extra parameters for information service

attribute.name: maxSizeBytes
attribute.description: Histogram x-axis limit for the total ROB request size per collect call per ROS

attribute.name: maxDurationMicroSeconds
attribute.description: Histogram y-axis limit for the total retrieval time per collect call per ROS

class.name: HLTRCApplication
class.description: Controller for the HLT Processing Unit application

attribute.name: numForks
attribute.description: Number of children to fork

attribute.name: numberOfAthenaMTThreads
attribute.description: Number of threads used in HLT implementation

attribute.name: numberOfEventSlots
attribute.description: Number of event slots in HLT implementation

attribute.name: getNextTimeout
attribute.description: Timeout value in ms for the requests of new events to the DCM

attribute.name: extraParams
attribute.description: Extra parameters in the format of key=value for unforeseen configurations

attribute.name: softTimeoutFraction
attribute.description: Fraction of softTimeout in HLTMPPU to hard Timeout in DCM. HLTMPPU will define softTimeout=softTimeoutFraction*(dcm->processor->processingTimeOut_ms) and call hltinterface->timeout() after softTimeout passed

attribute.name: SolenoidCurrentPath
attribute.description: Where is the solenoid current value is stored <partition>/<SERVER>.<OBJECT>.<FIELD>

attribute.name: ToroidCurrentPath
attribute.description: Where is the Toroid current value is stored <partition>/<SERVER>.<OBJECT>.<FIELD>

relationship.name: ROSLatencyMeasurement
relationship.description: If not null, a 2D histogram will be filled for each ROS. X-axis is the total number of bytes retrieved from the ROS(it can be combination of multiple ROBs), the y-axis is the total duration of retrieval in microseconds. This option should be left empty for physics runs.

relationship.name: InfoService
relationship.description: Link to the service in charge of publishing operational monitoring data and histograms.

relationship.name: MuonCalibrationConfig
relationship.description: Link to the circular buffer in which fragments for the muon calibration are stored.
